subject.title: [Feature]: Channels settings page should always show built-in channels alongside custom channels

question: Should maintainers adopt/review the open cross-repository PR for this issue, or close it and request a fresh same-repository replacement?
rationale: The issue remains valid, but an open linked PR already contains the focused resolver/test change and blocks a duplicate automated repair lane; its stale check state and non-maintainer-modifiable fork need human handling.

options.title: Review or adopt the linked PR
options.body: Use the existing focused patch if maintainers can refresh proof, reconcile the moved UI path, and resolve stale check state.

options.title: Request a fresh same-repository PR
options.body: Close or leave the fork PR aside and ask for a current-main UI-only resolver fix with focused proof.

recommendation.title: Review or adopt the linked PR
recommendation.body: Use the existing focused patch if maintainers can refresh proof, reconcile the moved UI path, and resolve stale check state.

likelyOwner.reason: The choice is closest to the channel UI metadata/catalog refactor path and the decision to adopt or replace the fork patch.
